notes: Bexar elections page (bexar.org/elections) links 'Election Night Returns' to Clarity EID 127291 (Nov 2026). The Clarity elections.json for Bexar is empty, so phase1.clarity_timeline reported every election 'not listed'; the same check 1 functions (read_detail, on_election_night) were run from scratch on EIDs 125927 (March 2026 primary) and 126369 (May 2026 runoff), found as clarityelections links on Wikipedia/San Antonio Report pages. Older Clarity versions return 404 (9 of 17 in the primary, 8 of 19 in the runoff), all of them pre-election-day or post-night. Vote-type sums per update confirm election-day precinct votes rising across night updates. 2024 general: the county's election-night 'Election Results' link (home.bexar.org/el45a.html) is an Electionware summary (county totals) report; official precinct reports are posted on the Historical Election Results page. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin). Last-Modified on the Clarity zips was not used; timestamps are from detail.xml.
tag_rationale: The 2026 primary and 2026 runoff were both LIVE by check 1 (Clarity update log), so two elections share LIVE and the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with high confidence.

2024_general.fact: home.bexar.org/el45a.html (linked as 'Election Results' from home.bexar.org) is 'Summary Results Report / Joint General, Special, Charter and Bond Election / November 5, 2024 / UNOFFICIAL RESULTS / Vote Center 302 of 302 / Bexar County', footer 'Election Summary - 11/06/2024 1:10 AM'; Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 07:11:00 GMT (01:11 CST). County totals only. Precinct numbers appear in the 'November 5, 2024 Official Precinct Report (PDF/CSV)' listed on the Historical Election Results page (post-canvass; the linked PDF returned 404 when fetched, so its date was not read). No separate election-night precinct page was found; check 3 pending.
